subject: Old School
author: Aaboe
body:
You know, zombie, I've actually never completed Takedown to 100%, as the last race with the silly car across the island always killed me (couldn't get gold, always crashed). But I've noticed something... in some ways it feels *slow* to race in Takedown after having done Paradise. And having played so much in Paradise, I've become much better at avoiding the traffic in Takedown 😉

Silly busy is right... I'm fortunately nearing the end of the crazy stuff, so I can get my stress level down (at max right now). And maybe, just maybe, I can get the level of painkillers down to where my doc wants it to be... tension headaches are a beach.

Cya laters, and come November I'll bring a friend online 😃

 

Aaboe

subject: Congratulations!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Congrats on getting Elite!! 👍

If you are gonna join us online, send a Friends Request to "BurnoutAholics", and enjoy the mayhem that follows!! 🚗 🎮

Cya Online,
